TVA based assessment can be used to model and predict cognitive performance in chronic stroke patients and to evaluate the effectiveness of cognitive training interventions.

TVA parameters are sensitive to attentional deficits following stroke, and that processing speed may be a key predictor for cognitive training outcomes.

the development and validation of an attentional model for clinical application in stroke.
the development of a novel, reliable and valid approach for assessment of attentional deficits following stroke and for monitoring of cognitive training effects in this population.

the development and application of a novel computational approach for the sensitive and reliable assessment of visual attention in stroke patients and the evaluation of a novel cognitive rehabilitation approach.
